page.overview:
Who is Desmond Dragonstrike?

is a dwarf who helped found Kraghammer in the wake of the Calamity. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

When Garen Hearthheart first encountered Desmond in Vasselheim's Brightforge neighborhood, Desmond was wearing a big, wide-brimmed hat, and his clothing bore a symbol that crossed a shepherd's crook with a hammer.

Garen was an amiable leader. He grew somber at the mention of Uthtor..}}

Desmond remembered the city of Uthtor from his young days, before the city's fall. He left that city in a hurry.
